![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

When destructuring function parameters, destructure from `params || {}` rather than relying solely on parameter defaults like `function foo({ bar } = {})` if the function can be called with an explicit `null`. This prevents a destructuring `TypeError` and allows the `null` input to reach internal validation logic.

```suggestion
export function validatePostAttemptMsRevealRuntimeFinalCloseout(params) {
  const { closeout = null } = params || {};
  const c = isRecord(closeout) ? closeout : {};
```

<details>
<summary>References</summary>

1. When destructuring function parameters, destructure from params || {} rather than relying solely on parameter defaults like function foo({ bar } = {}) if the function can be called with an explicit null. This prevents a destructuring TypeError and allows the null input to reach internal validation logic.
</details>

Fixed in 4c36e81b5: validatePostAttemptMsRevealRuntimeFinalCloseout now destructures from params || {}, so explicit null reaches fail-closed validation instead of throwing. Added a regression covering explicit null and non-record closeout input.
Fixed in 4c36e81b5: writePostAttemptMsRevealRuntimeFinalCloseoutArtifacts now destructures from params || {}, so explicit null no longer throws before defaulting.

Fixed in 4c36e81b5: sourceArtifactsPresent now indexes asArray(...).filter(isRecord) by non-empty role and validates every expected SOURCE_INPUTS role, emitting source_artifact_missing or source_artifact_missing_or_malformed per role. Added omitted and malformed source-artifact regressions.

Fixed in 4c36e81b5: upstreamValidatorsPass now derives expected validator roles from SOURCE_INPUTS, requires each expected validator to be present with pass, and flags unexpected roles. Added missing and unexpected validator-role regression coverage.

body: Fixed in 4c36e81b5: added fail-closed regressions for explicit null and non-record closeout input, missing upstream artifact input, omitted and malformed source artifacts, deleted expected validator keys, unexpected validator roles, and malformed live issue entries.
Fixed in 4c36e81b5: visualQaAssetBlockers now normalizes page_assets with asArray(...).filter(isRecord) before filtering and mapping blocker records.
Fixed in 4c36e81b5: locatorBlockers now normalizes rows with asArray(...).filter(isRecord), and applies the same record filtering to nested located_pages and locator_candidates before mapping.
Fixed in 4c36e81b5: liveIssueChainPass now normalizes issues with asArray(...).filter(isRecord), with regression coverage for null and string entries before the live chain check.
